state.screen: on, locked to the home screen, kept awake by a KEYCODE_WAKEUP every 20 s
state.connection: adb over Wi-Fi (USB data cable unplugged)
state.meter: battery charge counter in uAh, sampled every 60 s

result.conclusion: five background sync attempts changed drain by less than the meter's resolution; each attempt costs well under 1 mAh in the no-peer case

limitations: screen was on for both arms, so the absolute figure includes display drain and is not an idle-standby number
no paired device existed, so every attempt failed before any transfer; a real sync with data would cost more
single run per arm, no repeats, no thermal chamber
the device had to stay awake because wireless adb disconnects when the screen sleeps
